dashboard.title: Dashboard help
dashboard.intro: Your daily overview — what's due, what's overdue, and what to focus on.
items: The 5 cards at the top show tasks due today, overdue tasks, today's focus time, this week's progress, and your habit streak.
"Focus Now" lists your top tasks, automatically ranked by the Smart Engine (priority, due date, progress).
"My Areas" groups your open/completed tasks by area (Career, Health, Personal...) so you can see where things stand.
"Smart Insights" surfaces warnings and suggestions, like overdue tasks or an overloaded day.

today.title: Today help
today.intro: A focused view of what to work on right now.
items: "Do Now" lists urgent tasks that need attention today.
"Scheduled" shows tasks with a due date or start date today.
"Quick Wins" are short tasks (usually under 20 minutes) you can clear fast.
Tap any task to open it and edit details, mark progress, or mark it complete.

inbox.title: Inbox help
inbox.intro: A quick-capture list for tasks you haven't organized yet.
items: Use Quick Capture to jot down a task fast without filling in every field.
Every new task starts in Inbox until you assign it an area, project, or priority.
Regularly clear your Inbox by editing each task and moving it to the right area/project.

tasks.title: Tasks help
tasks.intro: The full list of every task, with filtering and sorting.
items: Use the filters to narrow by area, project, priority, or status.
Click "+ New Task" (top bar) to create a task from anywhere in the app.
Click a task row to edit it, or use the row actions to delete it.
Sort columns by clicking their header to find what you need faster.

projects.title: Projects help
projects.intro: Group related tasks into a project and track its health.
items: Each project card shows progress, task count, and a health status (Healthy, Attention, At Risk, Critical).
Health is calculated automatically from overdue tasks and how close the project is to its deadline.
Click a project to see all of its tasks and the suggested next action.

goals.title: Goals help
goals.intro: Track longer-term goals and link tasks to them.
items: Each goal shows its progress and status (On Track, At Risk, Completed).
Link tasks to a goal from the task's edit form ("Goal" field) so progress rolls up automatically.
A goal marked "At Risk" will also show up as a warning on the Dashboard and Smart Assistant.

habits.title: Habits help
habits.intro: Track recurring habits and build streaks.
items: Check in once a day (or per your habit's frequency) to keep your streak alive.
A streak resets if you miss a check-in on a required day.
Your longest current streak also shows up as a KPI on the Dashboard.

calendar.title: Calendar help
calendar.intro: See your tasks laid out by date.
items: Switch between month/week/agenda views using the controls in the header.
Click a day to see every task due that day.
Tasks are color-coded by priority so you can spot urgent days at a glance.

kanban.title: Kanban help
kanban.intro: Visualize task status as a drag-and-drop board.
items: Each column is a status (Inbox, To Do, In Progress, Waiting, Completed).
Drag a task card to a new column to change its status instantly.
The top task in each column is highlighted by the Smart Engine as the one to focus on next.

analytics.title: Analytics help
analytics.intro: Understand trends across all your tasks and habits.
items: Charts break down completion rate, tasks by area, and priority distribution.
Use this page to spot patterns — e.g. an area that's consistently behind.

assistant.title: Smart Assistant help
assistant.intro: Rule-based recommendations built from your real data — not a chat AI.
items: Tasks are grouped by recommended action (Overdue - do now, Quick win, Defer...), computed by the Smart Engine from priority, due date, and progress.
Project/Goal/Habit alerts here flag things that need attention — an at-risk goal, an unhealthy project, or a habit about to lose its streak.
This page never calls an external AI model — every suggestion is a plain rule over your own data, so it's instant and free.

settings.title: Settings help
items: General: workspace name, week start day, date format.
Task Defaults: what a new task starts with (status, priority, estimate).
Focus & Schedule: your working hours, used to calculate daily focus capacity.
Smart Engine: toggle which smart features are active — turning one off stops it from affecting sorting, warnings, or suggestions anywhere in the app.
